questions.q: When two lines intersect, vertically opposite angles are ____.
questions.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are always equal.

questions.q: The sum of angles in a linear pair is ____.
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles on a straight line add up to 180°.

questions.q: Two lines intersect and one angle is 60°. What is the vertically opposite angle?
A transversal is a line that ____.
options: cuts two or more lines at distinct points
questions.explanation: A transversal crosses other lines at different points.

questions.q: When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, corresponding angles are ____.
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles are equal for parallel lines.
